lesson.title: Verify Action and Stock Status Before Claiming Pending Checks
lesson.when: A customer requests an action, stock has already been confirmed in prior turns, and the action tool call has successfully executed
lesson.do: Confirm the request outcome using the updated status from tool execution rather than stating stock or status still needs checking
lesson.otherwise: You risk giving contradictory responses that claim a requirement is pending after it was already verified and processed
